notes.title: Steam Deck-optimized version of Startup Company
notes.notes:
Dear Startup Company players,

We have some exciting news to share with you. We are introducing a new version of the game that has been optimized for use with controllers. This means that the game will be fully compatible with the Steam Deck and other controller-based devices.

We recommend that players on desktop computers continue to play the regular version of the game as it provides the best experience in terms of gameplay, modding, and overall performance. However, if you prefer to play using a controller, the new controller-optimized version of the game will provide an equally immersive and enjoyable experience.

Please note that the controller-optimized version of Startup Company will not support modding, and savegames between the two versions are not compatible/shared.

To choose between the two versions, simply start the game as usual and you'll be prompted to select the desired game version:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/f967cb4fdbb6e0d647eac7e7337a1ff6451c834a.png

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Startup Company. We hope you enjoy the new controller-optimized version of the game!

Sincerely,
Hovgaard Games

notes.title: Startup Company is out in Full Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/f5b869a8a17b843a8adb704adbc80a3eecc756ff.png

Hi everyone! 

Today is the day! After four years and nine months of hard work, I can finally and proudly announce the Full Release of Startup Company!

If you read my special devlog about how Startup Company became a thing, you can probably imagine how excited I am about this. Today is the day I'm releasing the game I've been dreaming about. Startup Company is now officially out of Early Access.

Introducing Version 1 - Packed with new stuff!
I hope you're ready for this, because this update will be much longer than you're used to. Here's what's new in Version 1...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
2 New Website Types
By popular demand, you can now start the following two new website types: Dating Platform & Gaming Platform

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/30dbfbc10aa472fa4d7cb9e1c88a1b24c23858f3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
New feature: Profile Page
A new Profile Page feature is now available for all Gaming & Dating platforms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/c52207398b23a8e1af25b543661792320e91e792.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
20 New Competitors
With the new website types, I had to add some new competitors too. I asked my colleague Mark for some help naming these new competitors. As you can see, he was surprisingly creative!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/d63452af353a1734dcf113e6f66f197197cffc6a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
New feature: Early Retirement
Some of you really wanted to be able to retire early. I've listened and you can now find a "Retire now" button in your CEO's Retirement menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/32ea20d65517d091203a67cf24383655c18e468b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
Employees Menu: Mass-Upgrades!
I got more requests for this feature than I could count. Now it's here, upgrade all your employees at once!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/72b9c952f69e839c6f82b518e3a34370e08c538f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
Customize the "Days per year"
In order to get a nice balance between simulating a day's work and the progression of years, I've ended up shortening a year to 50 days in Startup Company. Some of you really did not like that, so I added the option to define the length of a year through the Custom Game menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/12a3fdf6501110b82b9d1d471772a30f8b5288bc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
New feature: Sell Your Website
This feature request has been so popular that you'll even find mods adding the functionality. I'm happy to report that it's now natively in the game. Obviously websites can only be sold if you've already bought out all the investors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6ae6d1ff5feca48c9e81bba8bcd64b5ef8875ddb.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
In-game Achievements
As Version 1 introduces a "direct download" option, I have created an achievements menu in-game, meaning achievements are no longer limited to Steam users.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/e28ca3aab2de932b6b4f4ffa80f571a0b6ecab47.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
New office items!
We've now got some new cool items for your office:

 Huge Slide: What's a big headquarter without a huge slide?
 Game Console Area: Again, a sign of success. You need it.
 Large Plant & Rectangular Plant: This is the sequal to the current "plant in a vase."
 Indoor Tree: Big offices always have indoor trees for some reason. Now you can too.
 Privacy Walls: Give your employees a bit more privacy with these walls.
 Privacy Box: A box canceling all noise coming from inside it. Very modern.
 Egg Chair: Probably the most expensive chair in the world.
 Letters (A-Z): Motivate (or unmotivate) your employees with these letter-shaped objects.

All the new items except the letters can be demanded by new employees and come with various new bonuses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6d37508abfba5573503f989c9ebbee526ec7a3c4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
Improved HR Management
Most of you have probably experienced losing a good employee, simply because you didn't accept a salary raise in time. You can now let your HR Managers handle this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/668c3037c3881e1527b1c1228beefac568ef0f77.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
Better Production Plans
The production plans has now been moved to an independent tab of the Inventory Menu. Options to more precisely control production behavior has also been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/5f6a31b50c7f22cb420b6f27389577812024f1cb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
Other Improvements
 Fixed components incorrectly shown as locked.
 "Game paused" shown when the time machine running.
 Slider's maximum salary too low.
 Limited Help System to one instance per website.
 Reduced organic growth.
 Introduced Jeets earlier in the game.
 Added logo selector to "new game dialog."
 Improved auto-save to save only after further progression.
 Added random name generator to "new game" dialog.
 HR manager's exhaustion is now easier to understand.
 Newly hired employees can no longer be fired right away.
 Fixed overlays causing people to get stuck on slower computers.
 Fixed bug allowing outsourcing tasks to be completed instantly.
 Purchased furniture can now be sold again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
Bugs and balancing
As with any release, there will of course be bugs and changes that need rebalancing. As always, I'll monitor the Steam discussions and apply hotfixes ASAP. 

I'm also planning on releasing a few updates to address various UI/QOL issues.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png
What's next at Hovgaard Games?
So much! As we're now a full-blown company with the resources to explore multiple paths, our roadmap looks like this:

Localizor.com
With Localizor we're revolutionizing the way games are translated by building an intelligent and community/crowd-based platform. We'll continue to invest heavily in improving the platform.
Visit Localizor.com

The Next Game
I can't count how many times I've been asked, "Is there another game coming from Hovgaard Games?" I can finally reply with a confident "Hell yes!" 

We're already busy creating the first concept art and I can't wait to show you everything. For now, I'll give you a few hints: 
 It's once again a tycoon/management game.
 The camera angle is topdown/isometric and the gameplay is something we're confident you have never seen before in this genre.
 The budget for the new game is 50 times (!) bigger than it was for Startup Company.

Make sure to follow Hovgaard Games on Steam to stay updated!

Once again! I hope you enjoy Startup Company – now in it's final form ːschappyː

Thanks for reading and for your continuing support!

All the best,
Jonas and the Hovgaard Games team

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0c1ca7ac449e5f5cf87e27e7aa571c5c6a2f45d9.png


I want to thank all of you who helped translate the remaining strings on Localizor. All languages have reached 100% except Korean and Japanese. Those will be added later. If you want to contribute the link is: https://www.localizor.com/game/1/translations

Lastly, I have to end with a sneak peek. Ready for some new furniture?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6d37508abfba5573503f989c9ebbee526ec7a3c4.jpg

See you tomorrow, it's going to be a big day!

All the best,

notes.title: 14 days to Full Release and I need your help!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're all as excited about the full release as I am. There's only 14 days left now and we're super busy fixing the last bugs and issues. I really want to make sure everything works flawlessly when you receive it.

https://www.localizor.com/game/1/translations

That's all for today :-) 

Stay safe everyone and enjoy the weekend!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Startup Company Official Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm super happy to finally share the official release date of Startup Company:

April 10, 2020

This means the game will finally move out of Early Access and into full release. I have decided not to increase the price and keep the current $12.99 (or your regional equivalent).

Countdown has begun on our new website!
Make sure to visit the official website and sign up for the countdown. By signing up, I'll send you an email 1 hour before Version 1 releases!

Check it out here: https://www.startupcompanygame.com

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/c5f71eaa8ebad40e9c2f6a9404d8958a163b41ac.jpg

Questions and Answers
Will there still come new content to the game, as usually?
No. Version 1 is the last content update.

What if I find a bug, will it be fixed?
Yes! All bugs we might have been missed will be fixed as usual through hotfixes.

Will Startup Company continue to work on future Operating System updates?
Yes, we'll continue to support the game and bring updates if necessary.

Is there any DLC planned?
Not currently planned, no.

Is Startup Company coming to other platforms?
Yes. We expect to release on XBox, Playstation and Nintendo Switch. Official annoucement will come later this year.

Can you tell anything about future games coming from Hovgaard Games?
No comments ːschappyː

Will there ever be a Startup Company 2?
No comments ːschappyː

I'm super excited to show you version 1! Stay tuned :-)

Thanks for reading!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Beta 12.7 Released - The Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm super excited to finally release this update to all of you. Since release the biggest complaint has been lag and performance issues when workstation count increases.

The solution was not easy and I'm not even done yet. I've been rewriting large parts of the code base to make rendering more efficient. This rewrite also allows me to improve performance further.

Hopefully this update will make the game playable for most players. I'm still targeting a lot of performance improvements in the future.

System requirements on the Store page have also been increased. I will reduce the requirements as more improvements are implemented.

Beta 12.6 changes (hotfix)
- Issue causing some users not being able to load savegames

Beta 12.7 changes

Features:

 Added Russian localization
 Added Turkish localization
 Disabled user loss for products until it's fully fixed (was causing players to lose all users overnight).


Fixes:

 Optimized the way workstation updates is rendered.
 Detached internal lifecycle from UI.
 Optimized amount of repaints to reduce CPU usage.
 Automatically disable Developer Mode after second launch (some players were not able to start game after enabling it).
 Optimized the way user growth was calculated (was exponentially increasing calculation time).
 Fixed bug where crashing mods could not be unsubscribed.
 Disable F5 and F12 shortcuts if Developer Mode is disabled.
 Increases amount of candidates generated.
 Fixed various translation issues.
 Show managers in HR Managers employee list.


Next up
Even though I would love to keep working on performance, I will now move my focus to fixing bugs. You have all been very active at reporting bugs, so I have plenty of work ahead of me :-)

Thank you for your attention, I hope you enjoy this update!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Post-Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Much feels
Wow. Just wow. This has been the craziest weekend, probably in my life. The Early Access release has been better, than I ever could have imagined. 

Within a few hours of release, Startup Company was present on Steam Global Top Sellers. More than 1000 concurrent players have been building companies non-stop since the release. I feel incredible humble and grateful. It's hard to believe. All of this would never have happened without you guys, the community. Thank you, really, the support has been tremendous!

So those of you who have been following me for some time, know that I'm not a full time game developer. I work as Web Developer and have created SC in my spare time. Well, that's about to change. In the future, I will work full time on Startup Company! As you can imagine, this allows me to put 2 or 3 times more hours into the development. I cannot wait. I got so much amazing feedback from all of you. Now it's time to really make this game awesome!

UPDATE: LIRIK just played the game. I'm absolutely starstruck! You can watch it here: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/166687767?t=01h15m51s

Beta 12.4 hotfix released
No release without the need for an urgent hotfix. If you don't see the "Beta 12.4" in your main menu simply restart Steam for the update to kick in.

    Exit button not clickable on small resolutions (less than 758 pixels height)
    Moving workstation by mistake instead of selecting employee (Changed to left click to select, right click to move).
    Mod archives was corrupted and didn't work on Mac/Linux under some scenarios. All mods has to be republished (sorry).
    The Day 31-email was causing lots of people to believe I accused them for piracy. The paragraph has been removed (that was never my intention, you're my heroes!).


Next update
I'll now focus on the following:

    Users suddenly drops overnight for products.
    Performance/optimization issues in mid/late-game.
    General minor bug fixing


I'm trying to keep up with all the comments, emails, tweets, chat messages and bug reports. I'm sorry if you're still waiting. I'm doing everything I can to keep up :-)

That's all for now. Thank you for all your amazing support! 

See you till next update.

Jonas

notes.title: Official Release Date: 11th of August
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just a super quick update. I'm going against the recent trend: I'm moving the Steam Early Access release one day backwards.

The release date is changing from 12th to 11th of August 2017.

I hope you find this small change acceptable :-)

Steam keys will be send out to all pre-orders very soon, so all you early birds are ready from the beginning. You can redeem the game on Steam, but it will simply now be playable until 11th of August.

The Steam release will include Beta 12, containing the Competitors & Stocks update and many other tweaks and updates.

That's all from me.

All the best,
Jonas

Hi everyone!

I can finally announce the official release date of Startup Company (Early Access):

Right now I'm working hard on getting the Steam integration done for all platforms. Hopefully achievements and Trading Cards will be ready for the EA release.

If you haven't already, please consider clicking the "Add to wishlist" button, even if you have pre-ordered already (it will boost the game on Steam!).

To everyone who pre-ordered the game at www.startupcompanygame.com: You will receive a Steam key by email shortly after the EA release.

That's all for now. if you like the game, tell your friends :-) All help spreading the news is super duper much appreciated!

All the best,
Jonas
